title: Setup for Linux (Fedora/Bazzite)
author: ArS-13
selftext:
Hey there ai enthusiasts, 

I want to improve my current workflow and move away from plain web chats. I once setup antigravity with the help of itself but it's not really great and as Google Gemini free tier gets shut down, I would appreciate a good setup with Claude or GPT.

But their Linux had been an issue  the last time I looked without any really support and I don't want to run everything through the command line.  But now I looked back into is and for GPT I saw an announcement that it supports now also beta version for fedora with an rpm while both seems to support Ubuntu at least - of course all in beta. 

Last year I switched over to bazzite which is based on fedora so I hoped getting the new rpm set up would be easy now... 

So looking into it, AI told me to still do a setup via distrobox but I'm not sure if all the tool calls and the possibility to use cool pipelines like the blender integration and other stuff really works without issues.

So if anyone uses a dev pipeline for bazzite I would really appreciate to know how you did the setup and what works and what not. And if you use another Linux system let me know about that too!
